name: e4_data_trends
caption: Reference data of E4: kinetic energy, magnetic energy and magnetic helicity of the saturated dynamo against η (mean over 24 trajectories, bars: ± 2 standard errors), with the training, validation and held-out values.

name: e4_helicity_spectrum
caption: Reference data: shell spectrum of the magnetic helicity and of the current helicity ⟨j·B⟩ at the three held-out η. The mean of ⟨j·B⟩ is zero (stationarity identity): the negative shells k ≤ 2 cancel the positive shells k ≥ 3.

name: e4_ed_ratio
caption: Energy distance to the reference divided by the noise floor on the held-out η, per variant: one dot per seed, bar: seed mean ± 2 standard errors (drawn with at least 5 seeds), open circle: seed mean at the training η. Dashed line: the floor.

name: e4_spectra
caption: Shell spectra of the velocity and of the magnetic field and magnetic helicity spectrum at the held-out η = 0.0490: reference (black) and generated ensembles (mean over the seeds).

name: e4_physics_metrics
caption: Physical metrics on the held-out η, one dot per seed and seed mean ± 2 standard errors: residuals of the mean total and magnetic energy balances, errors on the mean magnetic helicity and on the number of magnetic null points, drifts of the magnetic and kinetic energies when the solver restarts from the generated snapshots. Dashed lines: the same quantity on reference snapshots.

name: e4_per_eta
caption: Energy-distance ratio against η, seed mean: at the training values (filled circles) and between them (open squares: validation, open diamonds: held-out test). The gap between the two shows how each model interpolates in η.

name: e4_nulls_klambda
caption: Number of magnetic null points against the magnetic Taylor wavenumber k_λ = (⟨|j|²⟩/⟨|B|²⟩)^½, generated over reference, one point per variant, held-out η and seed; the fit is the one of the digest (hypothesis H13).

name: e4_floors
caption: Noise floors of the energy distance on the reference data: between two subsamples from disjoint halves of the 24 trajectories (mean of the 10 splits that define the floor of the ratio; bars: smallest and largest of 20 splits) and between two random subsamples.

name: e4_convergence
caption: Convergence of the reference data: energies and magnetic helicity at the three held-out η for the 16³ grid of E4, the same grid recomputed on the hardware of the check, half its time step, 24³ and 32³ (one η); bars: ± 2 standard errors over 24 trajectories.

name: e4_width_scan
caption: Width scan (hypothesis H21): energy-distance ratio and flow-matching loss of the equivariant potentials model without affine term for three widths and two budgets, against the model with the explicit affine term and the Gaussian baseline. Dashed line: π/2, the loss of the exact field for independent unit Gaussian coordinates.

name: e4_long_trainings
caption: Gaussian baseline (violet), flow matching with the explicit affine term or the Gaussian anchor at the base budget (blue) and with 8 times the iterations (orange), on the held-out η: one dot per seed, seed mean ± 2 standard errors.

name: e4_restart_curves
caption: Restart test anchored on the reference: energy of the ensemble advanced by the solver, relative to the stationary energy of the reference at the same η, against the time after the restart (τ = 0: the bias of the law). Mean over the held-out η and the seeds; bars: ± 2 standard errors over the seeds; grey band: reference snapshots.

name: e4_production_split
caption: Mean magnetic production over the Ohmic dissipation at the three held-out η, split into the part carried by the mean flow and the second moments of B and the third-order part; the two parts of a stationary law sum to 1 (dashed line). Reference: bars ± 2 jackknife standard errors over the trajectories; laws: ± 2 standard errors over the seeds.

name: e4_anchor_training
caption: Flow matching anchored on the Gaussian law with the full covariance (G1), read along one training of 4000 iterations; iteration 0 is the untrained model, which is G1 integrated like any model. Energy distance over the noise floor; third-order part of the magnetic production over that of the reference, per held-out η; largest deviation over the held-out η of the mean-flow production and of the magnetic energy from the reference; flow-matching loss on a fixed training sample. Seed means; bars: ± 2 standard errors over the seeds.

name: e4_gpu_costs
caption: Cumulative GPU spend of the pilot, one point per entry of the compute ledger: finished jobs, jobs that failed, were interrupted or were lost, and the corrections made after another session deleted running pods.
